detail.title: BASE Scale Level 3 Inference Barrier and Semantic Digital Twins
detail.summary: The BASE Scale taxonomy identifies the 'Inference Barrier' at Level 3, representing a critical transition for autonomous scientific agents. This barrier marks the shift from reliance on scalar-feedback loops to the utilization of semantic digital twins, which are required for temporal gating and synchronizing experimental acquisition with transient physical events.
detail.reason: Synthesis of current taxonomy proposals for autonomous scientific agents to define the Level 3 Inference Barrier requirement.
